diagrams.title: From Training to Consequences of Non-Compliance
diagrams.subtitle: Train, prove, monitor, then measure the impact of a gap.

quiz.question: Which step produces attestations and acknowledgements?

nodes.label: Training
nodes.detail: Train personnel on applicable obligations: data handling, anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, and anti-bribery.
nodes.exam: Training covers business obligations, not just technical tools.

nodes.label: Evidence
nodes.detail: Formal compliance statements and recorded confirmations of policy acknowledgement.
nodes.exam: Both artifacts are required in §5.4 and absent from the provided books.

nodes.label: Oversight
nodes.detail: Periodic controls, access and processing reviews, metric tracking, and reporting to leadership.
nodes.exam: Compliance without oversight cannot be demonstrated over time.

nodes.label: Identified gap
nodes.detail: A deficiency is identified through an internal audit, an incident, or an external inspection.
nodes.exam: The root cause must be tracked, not just the observed gap.

nodes.label: Consequences
nodes.detail: Reputational, financial, legal, contractual, sanctions, and loss of license.
nodes.exam: Revocation of an operating permit is classified as loss of license, even if it also has a financial cost.

nodes.label: Rights & retention
nodes.detail: Right to be forgotten, opt-in/opt-out, correction, processing restrictions, controller/processor roles, and legal hold overriding normal retention.
nodes.exam: A legal hold overrides a 30-day deletion policy.
